  GitHub の Issue からご連絡ください。

The images under `dist/assets/` (sprite atlases, stage backgrounds, key art, OGP image)
are excluded from the MIT License. They are AI-generated illustrations that reference
historical portraits of real persons (sources listed in the in-game archive and
`dist/portrait-sources.js`). Please do not redistribute, modify or use them commercially
outside of hosting this repository as-is (treated as CC BY-NC-ND 4.0). Takedown or
correction requests from rights holders will be honored promptly via GitHub Issues.
